# Raw fixtures: NOAA Chart Display Service

All recorded on 2026-11-08 (between 14:20 and 14:32 UTC) with `User-Agent: underbite-scout/0.1 (provider docs check)`. The ArcGIS Server behind these URLs intermittently answers HTTP 200 with an error body; every file below holds a good response (see docs/providers/ncds.md).

- `noaa-chart-display-rest-mapserver.json`: `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/MCS/NOAAChartDisplay/MapServer/exts/MaritimeChartService/MapServer?f=json`
- `noaa-chart-display-wms-capabilities.xml`: `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/MCS/NOAAChartDisplay/MapServer/exts/MaritimeChartService/WMSServer?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities` (WMS 1.3.0)
- `noaa-chart-display-wms-layers2-3-battery-256.png`: `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/MCS/NOAAChartDisplay/MapServer/exts/MaritimeChartService/WMSServer?SERVICE=WMS&VERSION=1.3.0&REQUEST=GetMap&LAYERS=2,3&STYLES=&CRS=EPSG:3857&BBOX=-8243208,4965255,-8234302,4974067&WIDTH=256&HEIGHT=256&FORMAT=image/png&TRANSPARENT=TRUE` (depths and seabed groups, lower Manhattan and the East River)
- `noaa-charts-wmts-capabilities.xml`: `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/MarineChart_Services/NOAACharts/MapServer/WMTS/1.0.0/WMTSCapabilities.xml`
- `noaa-charts-wmts-z14-x4823-y6160.png`: `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/MarineChart_Services/NOAACharts/MapServer/WMTS/tile/1.0.0/MarineChart_Services_NOAACharts/default/default028mm/12/6160/4823.png` (TileMatrix 12 is Web Mercator zoom 14; The Battery)
- `noaa-charts-wmts-z16-x19291-y24640.png`: `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/MarineChart_Services/NOAACharts/MapServer/WMTS/tile/1.0.0/MarineChart_Services_NOAACharts/default/default028mm/14/24640/19291.png` (TileMatrix 14 is zoom 16; soundings and contours off the Battery)
- `ncds-tilecache-metadata-query.json`: `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/MarineChart_Services/ncds_tilecache_metadata/MapServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&f=json` (the list behind the MBTiles download page: 43 regions with download URLs and sizes)

## Structure points (recorded 2026-11-17, same `User-Agent`)

Abbreviations in the URLs below: `M` = `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/MCS/NOAAChartDisplay/MapServer/exts/MaritimeChartService/MapServer`; `W` = the same path ending `/WMSServer`; `E` = `https://gis.charttools.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/encdirect`. A file holds a good response unless its name or line says otherwise. The WMS pixel queries use `VERSION=1.3.0&CRS=EPSG:3857&STYLES=&BBOX=-8236000,4948000,-8228000,4956000&WIDTH=1024&HEIGHT=1024` (Web Mercator, about 8 m per pixel, the Lower Bay south of Coney Island). Only the error files and the Okaloosa search lie outside the test places.

- `ncds-mcs-identify-error-2026-11-17.json`: `M/identify?f=json&geometry=-8238310,4969800&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&sr=102100&layers=all:0,1,2,3,4,5&tolerance=20&mapExtent=-8243208,4965255,-8234302,4974067&imageDisplay=256,256,96&returnGeometry=true`; HTTP 200 with `{"error":{"code":500,"message":"Error in handling operation identify"}}`; the same body for six variants (4326 and 102100 input, `layers=all`, `visible`, `top`, `all:0`), on every try
- `ncds-mcs-layer-query-invalid-url-2026-11-17.json`: `M/3/query?f=json&where=1%3D1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&resultRecordCount=3`; HTTP 200 with error 400 `Invalid URL` (a display group is not an addressable layer)
- `ncds-mcs-query-database-not-enabled-2026-11-17.json`: `M/query?f=json&geometry=-8238310,4969800&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=102100&layers=3&outFields=*`; HTTP 200 with error 400 `database not enabled`
- `ncds-mcs-find-okaloosa-fish-haven-15-2026-11-17.json`: `M/find?f=json&searchText=Okaloosa%20Fish%20Haven%2015&layers=0&contains=true&returnGeometry=true&sr=4326` (a text search over attribute values; the New York charts name no fish haven, so a Florida one shows the shape: S-57 object type `OBSTRN`, category "fish haven")
- `ncds-wms-gfi-layer3-wreck-no-depth-lower-bay-2026-11-17.xml` and `.html`: `W?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetFeatureInfo&LAYERS=3&QUERY_LAYERS=3&I=650&J=628&INFO_FORMAT=text/xml&FEATURE_COUNT=20` (and `text/html`) plus the common parameters; a `WRECKS` point, `VALSOU` empty, near 40.583 N 73.940 W
- `ncds-wms-gfi-layer3-wreck-valsou-lower-bay-2026-11-17.xml`: same, `I=903&J=306`; a `WRECKS` point with `VALSOU` 2.6, near 40.6006 N 73.9218 W
- `ncds-wms-gfi-layer3-obstruction-area-lower-bay-2026-11-17.xml`: same, `I=770&J=450`; an `OBSTRN` area (foul area), `VALSOU` empty
- `ncds-wms-gfi-layer2-depth-area-contour-lower-bay-2026-11-17.xml`: same with `LAYERS=2&QUERY_LAYERS=2&I=650&J=632`; `DEPCNT`, `DEPARE` (`DRVAL1`, `DRVAL2`)
- `ncds-wms-gfi-layer5-restricted-caution-area-lower-bay-2026-11-17.xml`: same with layer 5; `RESARE`, `CTNARE`. The value of the `txtdsc_token` attribute (a server-made reference string) was replaced with `REDACTED`; nothing else was edited
